rule: X — The Hollows through the year
texts: When sky-cats hunt the Cliff Path, the Hollows lanterns produce many threads.
In deep winter the Hollows lanterns produce a small thread harvest.
Through spring and summer the Hollows lanterns produce a steady thread harvest.
The Hollows Keepers often tend lanterns in pairs.
The fog makes the inland paths confusing.
The Hollows Keepers meet each week at a shed at the forest edge.

fields.sentence: When sky-cats hunt the Cliff Path, the Hollows lanterns produce many threads.
parse: (: e5_rule (Implication (And (Member $y sky_cat) (Member $e1 hunt) (Agent $e1 $y) (Theme $e1 cliff_path)) (And (Member (sk_produce $e1) produce) (Agent (sk_produce $e1) sk_lanterns_1) (Patient (sk_produce $e1) (sk_threads $e1)) (GroupOf (sk_threads $e1) thread) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_threads $e1) "many") (During (sk_produce $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a distributive predicate over a definite plural group occurring inside a whenever-rule conclusion -- the mandated per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...)` distribution rule has no licensed place to sit inside another rule's conclusion, so the group-only emission is forced

'many' as a vague count on a bare-plural object -- it is enumerated as a proportion word (strength 0.7) and is absent from the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity list ('a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of'), so its counting use has no stated canonical lexicon string or seeded bound
review.notes: The bare-'when' routing to the whenever machinery (generic premise participants, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, `During` link), the 'Cliff Path' name-plus-kind-atom treatment, the Northgate-style `Possession` link for the 'Hollows' proper-noun premodifier, the definite-plural group witness, and the per-occurrence Skolem thread group with its CardinalityPhrase all follow the instruction set. Emitting no QuantifierPhrase companion is correct on both counts -- 'every time / whenever' takes none, and the bare plural 'sky-cats' carries no quantifier word.

fields.sentence: In deep winter the Hollows lanterns produce a small thread harvest.

q2_gaps: a bare, adjectivally modified season frame ("in deep winter"): it is neither a structured calendar term (no Season constructor exists beside Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute) nor a deictic constant of the last_spring/next_summer shape, so the fused bare Time symbol deep_winter is an extrapolation and the modifier "deep" gets no treatment of its own
review.notes: The proper-noun-premodifier route for "the Hollows lanterns" (Name + opaque Possession, head parsed normally, no invented kind atom for Hollows), the definite-plural group, thread_harvest with its genus, the un-fused descriptive "small", and Patient for the produced harvest all follow the instruction set. Whether "produce a small thread harvest" is collective (group-only, as parsed) or distributive is a judgment the instruction set leaves open.

fields.sentence: Through spring and summer the Hollows lanterns produce a steady thread harvest.

q1_issues.issue: 'Through spring and summer' is a coordinated temporal frame, not a 'from X to Y' extent, so making spring the interval Start reads a range the words do not state and drops the surface preposition 'through'.
End summer is the other half of the same problem — the two conjuncts of one 'and' coordination get different heads instead of distributing over a single temporal role.

If 'produce' counts as distributive, the definite plural group also owes the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) …) rule that the instruction set requires beside a group event, since only collective predicates (gather/meet/assemble) stay group-only.

q2_gaps: a bare season name as a time filler — the structured Time terms cover only Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and the deictic constants list only forms like last_spring / next_summer, so plain 'spring' / 'summer' has no stated encoding
'through' as a temporal-frame preposition — it is not one of the three words that license During, and no Time-role or preposition-named-oblique routing is stated for it
review.notes: The proper-noun premodifier 'the Hollows lanterns' is handled exactly per doctrine (head parsed normally, opaque Possession to the named entity, Name string excluding the head), and 'steady' correctly stays an unfused descriptive atom while 'thread harvest' fuses with its head genus.

issues.reason: Start / End are licensed only for an eventuality with a STATED extent ('from X to / until Y', 'since X' → Start, 'until Y' → End), and 'through spring and summer' states no endpoints, so (Start sk_produce_1 spring) asserts that the producing began in spring — a bounded run the sentence never claims.

Same over-assertion on the other conjunct: coordinated NPs are distributive by default — the predication is replicated per conjunct under the SAME head — so splitting one 'and' coordination across two different heads manufactures an interval instead of two like temporal atoms.

'Predicating over the group as a unit is the default here' licenses the group-only event, and the per-member rule is owed only where each member acts separately; with the single aggregate object 'a steady thread harvest', that rule — (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_produce $x) produce) (Agent (sk_produce $x) $x) (Patient (sk_produce $x) sk_harvest_1))) — would assert that each lantern produces the entire harvest, content the text does not state, so its omission is correct rather than a defect.

gaps_confirmed: a bare non-deictic season as a time filler: the structured Time terms cover Year / Month / Day / Weekday / Hour / Minute and the deictic constants are listed only in forms like last_spring / next_summer, so plain 'spring' / 'summer' has no stated encoding

'through' as a temporal-frame preposition: it is not one of the three words (during / while / throughout) that license During, a synonym head is barred, and no Time-role or preposition-named-oblique routing is stated for it
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form distributes the coordinated frame over ONE temporal head — two like atoms on sk_produce_1, one per season, rather than Start on the first conjunct and End on the second — but no fully compliant form is licensed for this sentence: the filler shape for a bare non-deictic season is unstated, and the throughout-force of 'through' has no carrier at all (During covers during / while / throughout only, and coining a synonym head is barred), so both are filed as gaps and the frame's span meaning is simply unencodable.
adjudication.notes: The two confirmed issues are one fault seen from each end — an interval was invented out of a coordinated frame — and it is an over-assertion, not merely a loss, which is what makes it a defect rather than gap-territory improvisation. The Hollows proper-noun-premodifier handling (Name string excluding the head noun, opaque Possession, no invented type atom), the thread_harvest genus with 'thread' unexposed, unfused descriptive 'steady', Patient for a created object, and the absent tense atom on the habitual are all correct.

review.notes: The numeral forces 'Nine Keepers' to count members of the kind (GroupOf + Cardinality + group event + per-member rule for a distributive predicate) while 'the Hollows' takes the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment with no invented type atom, and the counted plural correctly takes no QuantifierPhrase companion since a numeral is not a quantifier word.

fields.sentence: The Hollows Keepers often tend lanterns in pairs.

q1_issues.issue: The frequency adverb 'often' sets the 0.8 strength but its (QuantifierPhrase ... "often") companion is missing, and the companion is mandatory for every explicit quantifier word including a frequency adverb's.
'in pairs' answers *how*, which the oblique rule routes to the named roles rather than to a preposition-named (In ...) oblique.

q2_gaps: frequency adverb on a habitual whose subject is a named INDIVIDUAL: QuantifierPhrase's slots are <kind> <verb-lemma>, so there is no licensed companion shape, and the frequency strength has no stated carrier on a multi-atom event bundle (the dial addresses only a rule or a flat generic atom)
distributive-configuration PP 'in pairs' (also 'in shifts', 'in threes'): it answers *how*, but Manner's filler is specified as an adverb, so a how-PP with an NP object has no stated encoding
review.notes: 'The Hollows Keepers' is handled exactly as the capitalized-plural-label rule mandates — Name-only individual, no GroupOf and no per-member kind — and the non-specific bare-plural object correctly stays the bare kind filler. The 0.8 strength was spread across the role atoms as well as the event class, which the instruction set neither licenses nor forbids.

issues.reason: The companion's first slot is a <kind> and this subject is a Name-only individual, so no filler exists: the prompt bars a companion that restates 'a range that appears nowhere else in the parse', and hollows_keepers in the kind slot would put an individual in a class position, which the categorical discipline forbids.

Manner's filler is specified as an adverb and a mis-slotted Manner atom is expressly barred, so this how-PP falls to the open preposition-named oblique built on 'the preposition actually used' — (In sk_tend_1 pair) is true of the text and well-typed.

gaps_confirmed: frequency adverb on a habitual whose subject is a named INDIVIDUAL: QuantifierPhrase's <kind> <verb-lemma> slots have no filler, and the frequency strength has no stated carrier on a multi-atom event bundle
distributive-configuration PP 'in pairs' (also 'in shifts', 'in threes'): it answers *how*, but Manner's filler is specified as an adverb, so a how-PP with an NP object has no stated encoding
adjudication.notes: Both issues are contradicted by the reviewer's own coverage gaps — where the instruction set licenses no shape, the calibration line makes the parser's choice acceptable, and the 0.8 strength does carry the 'often' dial. 'The Hollows Keepers' as a Name-only individual and the non-specific bare-kind lantern object are both correct.

fields.sentence: The fog makes the inland paths confusing.

q1_issues.issue: The reified result state sk_confusing_1 is missing its (Experiencer sk_confusing_1 sk_group_1) bearer atom — the State-result shape mandates (Member sk_<state>_N <state>) AND (Experiencer sk_<state>_N <obj>), and the plural carve-out replaces only the FLAT (Member <obj> <state>) half with the per-member rule, leaving the state witness here with no link to what is confusing.

q2_gaps: a locational / positional adjective premodifying a noun ('inland paths') falls in neither list of the fuse decision: it is not one of the four fusing categories (term of art, nationality/origin, role title, material adjective) nor one of the incidental-description exclusions (colour, size, damage, mood), so whether to fuse inland_path (with its own positional modifier genus) or distribute 'inland' over the group's members is undetermined
review.notes: The definite plural group witness, the Agent role for the inanimate transitive subject, the unmarked (habitual) tense, the adjectival participle 'confusing' kept unlemmatized to 'confuse', the Patient object of the resultative, the Result link and the per-member flat-half rule are all correct.

issues.reason: The State-result shape mandates both (Member sk_<state>_N <state>) and (Experiencer sk_<state>_N <obj>), and the plural carve-out replaces only the FLAT (Member <group> confusing) half with the per-member rule — so sk_confusing_1 is left with no bearer and records a state of nothing.

gaps_confirmed: a positional / locational premodifier ('inland paths') sits in neither the fuse list (term of art, nationality/origin, role title, material adjective) nor the incidental-description exclusions (colour, size, damage, mood), while east_wing / upper_deck show positional modifiers fused elsewhere — so fuse-vs-distribute is undetermined for this class
adjudication.defect_summary: Add the bearer atom (Experiencer sk_confusing_1 sk_group_1) to the reified result state — or, if per-member states are wanted, mint them in the rule's conclusion as (And (Member (sk_confusing $x) confusing) (Experiencer (sk_confusing $x) $x)); the rest of the resultative bundle already conforms.
adjudication.notes: The distribute-over-members choice for 'inland' is acceptable improvisation in that gap — every atom is true and well-typed — so it is not a defect. The Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, the Patient object, the unmarked habitual tense, the Result link and the per-member flat-half rule are all correct.

fields.sentence: The Hollows Keepers meet each week at a shed at the forest edge.

q2_gaps: a GEOGRAPHIC part-noun compound ("the forest edge") — the compound possessor/whole rule prescribes (PartOf <part> <whole>) for "N1 N2" where N2 is a part of N1, while "a place inside a place is LocatedIn, never PartOf" prescribes LocatedIn for the same pair; nothing says which governs an edge / rim / mouth-type sub-region of a place, and the parse chose PartOf
review.notes: The capitalized-plural label is correctly a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no invented "keeper" typing; "each week" correctly takes (Every e 1 week) with no QuantifierPhrase companion and no status atom, matching the "every Monday" habitual example. "at" is a containment preposition, so LocatedIn on the shed and Location on the meeting event are both the licensed heads.
